DeepSeek Harness
At least 1.5 GiB of free storage is required to install this extension.
Optional AI workspace with an embedded Web UI

Official DeepSeek developer preview. Installation downloads a separate Node.js runtime and application. Configure models and select a workspace in the embedded page. Not installed by default; no API key is prefilled.

SnowLuma
Optional QQ OneBot bridge instead of NapCat

Provides QQ interoperability and OneBot v11 through the official distribution package. Install the Ubuntu desktop and original QQ first. Sign-in happens in the desktop, and AstrBot keeps its existing reverse connection on 6199. Not installed by default; the program is fetched from the official release when you install it.
The SnowLuma extension requires an ARM64 phone.
Install the Ubuntu desktop extension first.

Official license (required)

SnowLuma uses a source-available non-commercial license, not an OSI open-source license, and its native components are additionally bound by its EULA. Section 5.4 of the EULA requires prior written authorization for third-party packaging, automated deployment and commercial use. This extension works for personal non-commercial use by fetching the official package from the official release and does not ship its programs with the APK. Read the official LICENSE and EULA before continuing.

Connect AstrBot

In the SnowLuma WebUI, add a WebSocket client for the signed-in account: ws://127.0.0.1:6199/ws, role Universal, message format array, with the same token as the AstrBot OneBot connection (empty by default). The AstrBot OneBot connection does not need to be renamed or recreated.
